tables.desc: MONTHLY BILLING - ONE ORDER PER CYCLE DAY

jobs.name: CBBIL01J
jobs.desc: SELECT ACCOUNTS DUE THIS CYCLE, OPEN BILLING CONTROL RECORD

jobs.name: CBBIL02J
jobs.desc: CLOSE BALANCES AND CALCULATE MINIMUM PAYMENT

jobs.name: CBBIL03J
jobs.desc: BUILD STATEMENT LINE DETAIL FROM POSTED TRANSACTIONS

jobs.name: CBBIL04J
jobs.desc: FORMAT STATEMENTS FOR PRINT AND ELECTRONIC DELIVERY

jobs.name: CBBIL05J
jobs.desc: CREATE PRINT AND E-DELIVERY VENDOR FILES, TRANSMIT

jobs.name: CBBIL06J
jobs.desc: CLOSE BILLING CYCLE, SET NEXT CYCLE DATES, CYCLE REPORTS

tables.desc: NIGHTLY AUTHORISATION SETTLEMENT AND POSTING CYCLE

jobs.name: CBCRD01J
jobs.desc: OPEN CYCLE, VALIDATE CONTROL RECORD, TAKE VSAM BACKUP

jobs.name: CBCRD02J
jobs.desc: EXTRACT UNSETTLED AUTHORISATIONS FROM AUTHLOG

jobs.name: CBCRD03J
jobs.desc: SORT AND MERGE THE SETTLEMENT EXTRACT INTO POSTING SEQUENCE

jobs.name: CBCRD04J
jobs.desc: POST TRANSACTIONS TO ACCOUNT AND TRANSACTION TABLES

jobs.name: CBCRD05AJ
jobs.desc: FEE ASSESSMENT FOR THE POSTED DAY

jobs.name: CBCRD05BJ
jobs.desc: REWARD POINT ACCRUAL FOR THE POSTED DAY

jobs.name: CBCRD06J
jobs.desc: NIGHTLY EXPOSURE AND DELINQUENCY REFRESH

jobs.name: CBCRD07J
jobs.desc: INTEREST ACCRUAL ON REVOLVING BALANCES

jobs.name: CBCRD08J
jobs.desc: GENERAL LEDGER EXTRACT AND BALANCING

jobs.name: CBCRD09J
jobs.desc: DAILY OPERATIONS AND EXCEPTION REPORTING

jobs.name: CBCRD10J
jobs.desc: CLOSE CYCLE, ARCHIVE WORK FILES, RELEASE ONLINE REGION

tables.desc: WEEKLY REFERENCE AND CONTROL FILE REBUILD

jobs.name: CBREF01J
jobs.desc: BACKUP REFERENCE CLUSTERS AND OPEN THE REFERENCE CYCLE

jobs.name: CBREF02J
jobs.desc: REBUILD MERCHANT SETTLEMENT ROUTING AND REASON CODE FILES

jobs.name: CBREF03J
jobs.desc: REBUILD FRAUD RULE AND CUSTOMER PREFERENCE FILES

jobs.name: CBREF04J
jobs.desc: REBUILD THE ROUTE TABLE VSAM CLUSTER FROM THE DB2 CONTROL TABLE

jobs.name: CBREF05J
jobs.desc: VERIFY REBUILT CLUSTERS, REPORT, CLOSE THE REFERENCE CYCLE

tables.desc: WEEKLY PARTY EXPOSURE, SCREENING AND RISK RESCORE

jobs.name: CBPRT01J
jobs.desc: OPEN CYCLE AND REFRESH PARTY EXPOSURE FROM PRODUCT SYSTEMS

jobs.name: CBPRT02J
jobs.desc: LOAD SANCTIONS FEED AND REBUILD THE CONSOLIDATED WATCH LIST

jobs.name: CBPRT03J
jobs.desc: RESCREEN THE ACTIVE PARTY POPULATION AGAINST THE WATCH LIST

jobs.name: CBPRT04J
jobs.desc: RESCORE ACTIVE PARTIES, WRITE AUDIT, CLOSE THE CYCLE
